scientific_target: fixed-candidate retrieval-conditioned role-specific begin/end posterior injection

capacity.reason_no_mlp: Training and fine-tuning are prohibited; an untrained neural layer would reduce validity rather than raise the precision ceiling.

corrections.retrieval_gate: The suggested sigmoid-only gate could never reach g_max=1.75; multiplying by two centers the gate at one and makes both bounds reachable.
corrections.logit_gauge: Frozen exports contain probabilities, not identifiable raw-logit constants. Within-video normalization is required before endpoint log-probability changes can be compared across videos.

discarded_implementation_check.reason: Arbitrary per-video normalization constants leaked into cross-video scores.
